_README: Query / source catalog for the Privacy Exposure Monitor (P1).
Committable — contains NO PII, only query TEMPLATES. {v} is substituted with a
watchlist value at run time. The P4 recursive loop appends validated new
templates here (dev-loop style: propose -> Buddy approves -> apply, reversible).
share_link  — indexed LLM shared-chat exposure (the incident that started this).
own_footprint — pages Buddy himself put out (repos, pastes, his domains).
general     — open web mentions of a name/email/identifier.
people_search — data-broker / people-search listings (ONLY run for scope=full).
Placeholders: {v} = the value (quoted automatically for emails/names).
breach_note: Emails are additionally checked against Have I Been Pwned (api/v3) when hibp_api_key is set in credentials.json (dormant until keyed).
